subject: Residency carveout & HSM amortization — procurement timeline and discount bands
messages:
From: Sara Voss <sara.voss@neurowell.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.example.com
Cc: david.ross@neurowell.com, procurement@neurowell.com
Date: Wed, 3 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Residency carveout + HSM amortization questions

Markus — thanks again for yesterday's call. We’re regrouping internally and have two asks so we can move the SOW to procurement: 

1) Can you send a clean breakdown showing how you're treating the HSM seat/license vs recurring residency/egress fees (we need an amortized view over 24 months).
2) On audit logs: we need a clear monthly tiered price for retention beyond 1 year (12-24-36 months) and an estimate for monthly ingest cost for our expected 15M tokens/month.

Also, our legal team flagged the evidence-delivery milestone (you mentioned a one-time evidence package fee). Legal prefers amortizing that over the first 6 months rather than billing upfront; is Redwood open to that?

I attached our procurement checklist and the rough timeline — we hope to have PO out by 2/18 if economics and terms are aligned.

— Sara

Attachments: neurowell_procurement_checklist.pdf (PDF, 45KB)
From: markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.example.com>
To: Sara Voss <sara.voss@neurowell.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.example.com, ben_carter@redwood.example.com, procurement@neurowell.com
Date: Wed, 3 Feb 2027 12:40:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Residency carveout + HSM amortization questions

Sara — thanks, appreciate the clear timeline. Attached is a draft breakdown (residency_pricing_v2.pdf) and a short evidence workflow matrix. High-level answers inline, and I’ll loop in finance for exact amortization lines: 

• HSM seat vs residency: we can present HSM as a one-time license amortized over 24 months (monthly charge = license / 24) + a smaller recurring per-seat support/monitoring fee. Alternatively, we can convert ~40% of the license into a time-bound implementation credit if you prefer lower upfront cash. 

• Audit logs retention tiers (monthly): 0-12mo included in base; 13-24mo: $0.015/token-month; 25-36mo: $0.010/token-month. These are placeholders — will validate with infra after you confirm the ingest volume. 

• Evidence-fee amortization: happy to amortize over 6 months as a concession for an annual commit or ≥12-month SOW. For Q1 pilot/POs under 6 months we'll need partial upfront. 

I'm marking this as an internal decision point for discount bands — copying Laura and Ben. We can offer incremental discounts tied to commit bands (12m/24m/36m) and a procurement-friendly payment cadence.

Next steps: I’ll push a numbered SOW draft (SOW-draft-Residency-HSM.docx) that encodes the amortization option and two price bands (standard / committed). If that looks good to you, we’ll surface it to legal for redlines.

— Markus

Attachments: residency_pricing_v2.pdf (PDF, 95KB); evidence_workflow.xlsx (XLSX, 38KB)
From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.example.com>
To: markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.example.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.example.com>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.example.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Feb 2027 15:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Internal: proposed concessions for NeuroWell (notes)

Quick internal thread — copying the ask and my suggested approach: 

On Wed, Feb 3, 2027 at 12:40 PM Markus wrote:
> • HSM seat vs residency: we can present HSM as a one-time license amortized over 24 months (monthly charge = license / 24) + a smaller recurring per-seat support/monitoring fee. Alternatively, we can convert ~40% of the license into a time-bound implementation credit if you prefer lower upfront cash.

My suggestions: 
- Offer two commercial paths: (A) 24m amortization of HSM license + 12% annual support; (B) 40% convert to implementation credit with 18m recognition (slightly higher effective yield but lower upfront).
- For evidence-fee: accept 6mo amortization if they commit to 12m min term. Otherwise require 50% upfront.
- Discount bands: 5% at 12m commit, 10% at 24m commit, 15% at 36m commit — these apply to residency and audit log line items only (not to one-time HSM license).

Operational asks: Ben — can you confirm whether audit log tier pricing matches our current ingest cost curve? I think our 13-24mo price is aggressive; if cost is higher we need to push $0.018/token-month.

— Laura
From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.example.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.example.com>, markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.example.com>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.example.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Feb 2027 08:23:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Internal: proposed concessions for NeuroWell (notes)

Laura — checked infra cost assumptions: for 15M tokens/month your monthly ingest is ~150GiB of compressed logs. Cost curve leads me to recommend: 13-24mo $0.017/token-month, 25-36mo $0.0115/token-month. The 0.015 and 0.010 in Markus' draft are slightly below our expected breakeven for the middle tier.

If we keep Laura's discount bands we still preserve margin if we push the middle tier to $0.017. Also confirm we can do evidence amortization 6mo for >=12m SOWs. Finance needs to see the SOW with the 24m amortization line item spelled out.

— Ben
From: markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.example.com>
To: Sara Voss <sara.voss@neurowell.com>, David Ross <david.ross@neurowell.com>, procurement@neurowell.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.example.com, ben_carter@redwood.example.com
Date: Tue, 9 Feb 2027 09:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Residency carveout & HSM amortization — updated commercial (SOW v2)

Sara / David — thanks for the patience. Per our internal review we updated the commercial lines and attached SOW v2 and the amortization sketch (SOW-draft-Residency-HSM.docx). Summary of changes: 

• HSM license: one-time fee of $180k, amortized over 24 months for invoicing (monthly amortized line shown). Support/monitoring fee: $1,200/month/seat. Option B: convert 40% ($72k) to a time-bound implementation credit recognized over 18 months if you prefer lower cash at signing.
• Audit log retention (15M tokens/month): 0-12mo included in base; 13-24mo: $0.017/token-month; 25-36mo: $0.0115/token-month. We included a worked example row in the spreadsheet for 15M tokens.
• Evidence package: will be amortized over 6 months for SOWs >= 12 months. For pilot < 6 months, we require 50% upfront.
• Discount bands (applies to residency + audit log repeatable usage only): 5% @12m commit; 10% @24m commit; 15% @36m commit. One-time HSM license not discountable.

If those terms look acceptable we can prepare a final SOW for legal redlines. Timeline note: if you need PO by 2/18, we recommend signing the commercial terms by 2/11 to allow legal review and DocuSign routing.

>

From: Sara Voss <sara.voss@neurowell.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.example.com
Cc: david.ross@neurowell.com, procurement@neurowell.com
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2027 15:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Residency carveout & HSM amortization — updated commercial (SOW v2)

Markus — appreciate the fast turnaround and the worked example. A few quick follow-ups from procurement and legal: 

• Procurement asks to see the PO-friendly pricing table (single row per charge with monthly invoice amount) — can you export that from the spreadsheet?
• Legal asked to confirm the implementation credit mechanics (if we choose the 40% convert option) — specifically: is the credit off future invoices only and non-refundable?
• Can you confirm lead time for HSM provisioning and whether provisioning milestone is tied to the first amortized invoice or billed separately?

If you can get those three answers + the PO table by end of day Thursday (2/12), we’ll circulate internally and target PO on 2/18.

— Sara
